# Formats and levels

The raw, zlib and gzip formats, and the compression levels.

<h2 id="format"><code>Format</code></h2>

```rux
pub enum Format: uint8 {
    Raw = 0,
    Zlib = 1,
    Gzip = 2
}
```

The container around a Deflate stream. `Copy`.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Compress/Src/Format.rux#L7)

**Cases**

| Name   | Value | Description                                                                                                  |
| ------ | ----- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `Raw`  | `0`   | A bare Deflate stream, RFC 1951, with no header and no checksum.                                             |
| `Zlib` | `1`   | The zlib format, RFC 1950: a two-byte header, the stream, and an Adler-32 of the data.                       |
| `Gzip` | `2`   | The gzip format, RFC 1952: a header that may name the file, the stream, a CRC-32 of the data and its length. |

<h2 id="level"><code>Level</code></h2>

```rux
pub enum Level: uint8 {
    Store = 0,
    Fastest = 1,
    Default = 2,
    Best = 3
}
```

How hard the compressor looks for repeated data. `Copy`.
Higher levels find longer and more matches and so write less, and take longer to.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Compress/Src/Format.rux#L19)

**Cases**

| Name      | Value | Description                                                                                |
| --------- | ----- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `Store`   | `0`   | No compression: the data is stored as it is, in blocks a decompressor copies straight out. |
| `Fastest` | `1`   | The quickest search: the first match found is taken.                                       |
| `Default` | `2`   | A balance of speed and size, close to zlib's default.                                      |
| `Best`    | `3`   | The most thorough search this package does.                                                |
